data.change_summary: Comprehensive documentation update covering all seven planned work items from the docs plan. Created a new ARCHITECTURE.md developer entry point with conceptual overview, reading guide, and extension points. Updated README.md to replace the stale v0.1 limitations section with a scope/limitations narrative that honestly describes what the model measures, estimates, approximates, and where parameters are provisional. Updated aquarium_sim_review_vnext.md with resolution status on all 8 high-priority issues (6 resolved, 1 partially resolved, 1 resolved with labeling approach) and marked all v0.2-v0.6 milestones as done. Updated scientific_specs.md with a post-upgrade summary. Added a display policy compliance audit summary to UNITS.md confirming all TUI/API labels match the prescribed policy. Added a coverage summary table to PROVENANCE_STATUS.md showing annotation status across all parameter families. Added a cross-references section to spec.md linking to carbonate, habitat, shrimp, provenance, and calibration docs. Updated scientific_inventory.md sections 1.1, 1.3, 1.5, and 1.6 with current field names, resolved shortcuts, and upgraded status markers for the carbonate solver, habitat registry, and stage-structured shrimp model.
outstanding_risks: scientific_inventory.md is 60KB and only the most critical sections (1.1 pH, 1.3 shrimp/biofilter, 1.5 snapshot, 1.6 display semantics) were updated — other subsections may still reference pre-upgrade state in their 'Known shortcuts' columns.

The scope/limitations narrative must be reviewed by the project owner to confirm it threads the needle between honesty and user confidence — it describes approximations without defensive language, but the tone judgment is subjective.

The TUI chemistry detail screen displays pH at 3 decimals while UNITS.md policy says 2 — documented as acceptable for a detail view, but a code change could be made if strict policy compliance is desired.

aquarium_sim_review_vnext.md roadmap is now effectively a historical document since all milestones are marked DONE — external links to it as a 'next-step plan' (including the README reference) now point to implemented rather than planned work, which is the correct reading but may be confusing to someone expecting a forward-looking roadmap.

Plant presets, remaining source water (soft_acidic, ro_like), substrate indices, routing fractions, and thermal transport parameters still lack param_meta annotations per the PROVENANCE_STATUS.md coverage table — these remain candidates for future annotation beads.

steps.description: Audited existing docs against implemented code and verified which issues from aquarium_sim_review_vnext.md are resolved: 6 of 8 high-priority issues resolved, 1 partially resolved (microfauna routing), 7 of 9 medium-priority gaps resolved. All v0.2-v0.6 milestones confirmed implemented.

Created docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (~6KB) with conceptual overview, key abstractions (units, carbonate, habitat, shrimp stages, provenance), workspace layout, reading guide for four different goals (model understanding, chemistry, ecology, extending), and extension points for adding new guilds, habitats, chemical species, and parameters.

Audited all TUI labels (overview.rs, chemistry.rs, biology.rs, actions.rs) and API fields (snapshot.rs handler, chemistry_field_semantics) against UNITS.md policy. All nitrogen labels use mg N/L, TDS/conductivity say Est., GH/KH labeled as derived, precision defaults mostly match. Added compliance summary table to UNITS.md and marked migration beads as done.

Wrote scope/limitations narrative (~350 words) structured as: what the model measures, what it estimates, what it deliberately approximates, where parameters are provisional. Tone is educational and honest without defensive language.

Updated README.md: replaced v0.1 framing with scientific-core upgrade framing, expanded feature list (carbonate solver, habitat registry, stage-structured shrimp, provenance, calibration harness), replaced stale 4-bullet limitations with the scope/limitations narrative, added tank_harness to workspace layout, updated doc links to point to ARCHITECTURE.md as entry point.

Updated PROVENANCE_STATUS.md: added coverage summary table showing annotation status across 11 parameter families, verified that soft_acidic.toml, ro_like.toml, and plant presets still lack param_meta (confirming Not Yet Annotated section is accurate), updated version reference to tanksim-6e5.7.5.

Updated spec.md: added section 20.10 with cross-references to carbonate_state_contract.md, habitat.rs, shrimp_state_contract.md, PROVENANCE_STATUS.md, and validation_scenarios.md. Updated section 23 known simplifications to mark carbonate and shrimp as upgraded.

validation_evidence: git diff --stat shows 8 files changed (156 insertions, 72 deletions) plus 1 new file (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md at 6389 bytes).

All snapshot field names in updated scientific_inventory.md section 1.5 match the actual TankSnapshot struct fields in crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs (verified: tan_mg_n_per_l, nh3_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nitrate_mg_n_per_l, phosphate_mg_p_per_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l, estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l, estimated_conductivity_us_cm, sub_adult_count, repro_dominant_suppression).

TUI label audit confirmed all nitrogen fields show 'mg N/L', all TDS/conductivity labels say 'Est.', GH/KH labeled as derived — verified by reading overview.rs, chemistry.rs, biology.rs, and actions.rs.
API chemistry_field_semantics entries verified to match canonical snapshot field names and describe element basis correctly.

PROVENANCE_STATUS.md coverage table verified by grepping param_meta across all TOML files: process/default.toml (32 entries), hard_shrimp.toml (6), moderate.toml (6), active_planted.toml (1), coarse_porous.toml (1), neocaridina_davidi.toml (22); soft_acidic.toml, ro_like.toml, and plant presets confirmed to have 0 param_meta entries.
Carbonate solver implementation confirmed: temperature-corrected pka1() function and solve_carbonate_equilibrium() with quadratic solve exist in crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs.
Stage-structured shrimp confirmed: sub_adult_count field exists in TankSnapshot, animal.sub_adult state exists in biology types.
Habitat registry confirmed: HabitatKind enum with 5 variants and compute_habitat_registry() function exist in crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs.
ARCHITECTURE.md kept under 6.5KB to ensure it stays maintained, as specified in the docs plan.
